Harborside Chalet is a lovingly restored, traditional coastal New Englander cottage located on the hillside above beautiful Southwest Harbor, just 1 mile from Quietside Acadia’s best oceanfront hiking trails. Steps outside the maritime village of SW Harbor with semi-private ocean access, seaglass beach, dock, firepit, and a short walk to all village amenities: the town pier, local bars, restaurants with live outdoor music overlooking the marina, & a private charter on a wooden Friendship sloop. This Listing: The Harborside Chalet

🏠 The Cottage:
The Harborside Chalet is where Coastal Maine summer cottage tradition meets lux amenities. Recently renovated with beautiful original wood floors, modern furniture, hot tub, custom cedar outdoor shower, granite fireplace and Jotul wood stove complemented by high-end kitchen appliances, the Chalet offers a quintessential Oceanview Maine summer cottage for up to 12 guests—and we are dog-friendly! 

⭐️ Amenities!!!⭐️
⭐️Jotul Gas Fireplace
⭐️Luxury rainfall OUTDOOR SHOWER 
⭐️Super high temp stainless dishwasher
⭐️Large capacity washer dryer

🏝️ The View:
From the upper deck and the front-facing upstairs windows of the cottage, you are graced with a view of the harbor all the way out to the Cranberry Isles. The sun comes up over the ocean and our sunrises are amazing! 

🦞 From our waterfront, watch the lobster boats and sailing yachts pass by and see the fog roll in and out with the weather while listening to the foghorns as you relax in an Adirondack chair high above the harbor. At night, you’ll see the twinkle of boat lights and navigation lights marking the harbor in white, green, and red.

🌊 Waterfront Access: 
We are thrilled to offer our guests amazing WATERFRONT ACCESS  just across the street, including the gazebo, fire pit, and Adirondack chairs, dock, and beachfront! It’s a fantastic place to walk the dog, sit by the fire, and have a waterfront dinner under shelter. You can also arrange a private water taxi to pick you up on the dock, and head out to Isleford Dock Restaurant on Little Cranberry Island. The waterfront space is semi-private and shared with our other properties and the boat owners who rent dock space. 

To access, you’ll step outside onto Main Street and make a quick right, and just across the street, look for the Gazebo Trail on the left. It’s a beautiful, exclusive spot and I’m super excited to offer it to my guests! [The space] Entire Home [Guest access]

This luxury lakehouse is perfectly situated at the top of Acadia National Park, between Mount Desert Island and Schoodic Peninsula to explore all of Downeast Maine. The home is immaculate luxury. Facing West for perfect sunsets. Dock on the lake, kayaks, fire pit, reclaimed wood design, multiple game tables and gourmet kitchen. 4,500 sq ft of luxury on the water in Vacationland. What more could you ask for in family vacation home? The lakehouse is situated on 3 levels. The upstairs level has a master bedroom overlooking the main floor, a full bath, laundry, walk-in closet and office with exercise equipment.
The main level features vaulted ceilings with a central, 2-sided fireplace, a gourmet kitchen, dining room, great room, a massive covered deck with both a screened and unscreened section, a bedroom and full bathroom.
The lower level is a walk-out with 2 bedrooms, a game room, laundry and bathroom.
The back yard gently slopes to the lake where a private fire pit, small stone beach and boat dock await. Take the kayaks out for a morning paddle and enjoy the best of Maine.

The property has 3 kayaks for your use between Memorial Day and Labor Day. Always wear life jackets when using. Children must be accompanied by an adult. Host is not liable for any incident regarding kayak or dock.

We also have a ping pong table, air hockey table, foosball table, board games, books, fishing rods, tennis rackets and a set of golf clubs for you to use.

There is an additional rental package you can add on after booking that includes a 6'x18' matter mat, 6 person floating island and 2 standup paddle boards. [The space] The home has parking for 4 cars in the driveway. There is also a large additional parking area across the street, to the right (where our green dumpster is located) for parking any boat or skidoo trailers you wish to bring.
An Electric Vehicle Charger (Level 2, 40 AMP, J1772 standard) is available for a $100/stay/week surcharge. If you need the charger for your stay, message the host at least 24 hours before check-in to have the EV charger turned on for your stay. [Guest access] Min age of primary renter is 25+.
No parties allowed.

If you want to rent a power boat, stand up paddleboards, canoes or additional kayaks, Downeast Boat Rentals can deliver these to the property for your use. They are in very high demand. If you plan to rent we suggest making your reservations ASAP.
There is a public launch area at the southern end of the lake.

Please keep all children under close eye when around the water.

Internet is via high speed Starlink satellite internet. This is close to broadband quality and allows for video streaming, VOIP phone calls, etc.

We are just 10 minutes to the Sunrise trail and great hiking on Schoodic mountain.

We have a property manager that lives next door. He may stop in during the stay to check in and make sure that your stay is going smoothly. [Other things to note]

Enjoy a coastal haven with sunset views from your private ocean cove. Nestled among the pines with direct access from the property to kayaking, swimming, hiking, walking trails and seashore exploration. The home sits high above the water, with stunning ocean views where you can sip your morning coffee and watch wildlife from the spacious deck. Located 30 minutes to Acadia,  MDI and Schoodic; 40 minutes to Bar Harbor; 10 minutes to Ellsworth (groceries, restaurants, shopping). Gather family and friends in a beautiful coastal setting with plenty of space to relax, celebrate, and make memories. Enjoy a fully stocked kitchen for holiday meals, plus a Christmas tree to make your festive stay feel like home.

Christmas dates are still available—book your holiday getaway at Singing Shores!

Singing Shores is privately nestled along the shore of Kilkenny Cove, bordering conservation land and surrounded by trees, ocean, and a peaceful stream. Take a paddle around one of the nearby islands during sunset or choose to relax and enjoy the evening sky around the fire pit or from the comfort of the hot tub. The whole group will have a blast playing in the game rooms, which include ping pong, shuffleboard, Pop-a-shot basketball and an arcade room. When you want some down time, you can lounge in a hammock or take a stroll along the rocky shore during low tide and enjoy seeing eagles, herons, seals and marine life. The magnificent Great Room serves as the heart of the home, offering a generous gathering space with lots of natural light, plush seating and views of the ocean. It's the perfect place to unwind, share conversations, or simply take in the beauty of the coastline.

Situated halfway between Acadia National Park’s two primary locations on Mount Desert Island and on the Schoodic Peninsula (each 30 minutes away), and 5-20 minutes away from a variety of additional hiking, boating and ocean-themed outings, you will have no shortage of opportunities for adventure. 

The home is ~10 minutes away from Ellsworth with restaurants, groceries and shopping.

50053509.desc:
Saint Edwards Convent, built in 1908 and on the National Register of Historic Places! Come stay in one of the only examples of Jacobethan architecture in the United States! Used to be the museum and has a fully equipped chapel and confessional, with historic stained glass windows and beautiful architectural details! Just underwent complete restoration where every detail was considered! Right in the heart of downtown Bar Harbor and close to dining, shopping, and Acadia National Park!

 VR2R26-276 No expense was spared in this renovation, complete with gourmet kitchen with custom double oven and six burner stove. 7 bedrooms and 3.5 baths perfect to host groups of up to 16. Outfitted with memory foam Casper mattresses, and decor reminiscent of the Art Deco era, this home is truly an experience. We even offer two cruiser bikes for guest use!

The National Register of Historic Places stated:
"From an architectural standpoint, St. Edward's is noteworthy as a virtually intact example of a residential building designed in the Jacobethan Revival style. Characteristics of the style as described in American Architecture Since 1780: A Guide to the Styles (Whiffen, 1969) include the use of brick for walls and stone or a substitute such as concrete for window frames, parapets, quoins, and ornament, as well as steep sided triangular gables and bay windows. All of these elements are present in the design of the convent as developed by the local architect Milton Stratton."

The convent was built by the sister of Saint Katherine Drexel, who stayed at the Convent during her visits, and her dedicated herself to the causes of native Americans in the area.

49996131.desc:
Experience elegant waterfront living in a contemporary architect-designed version of a traditional Maine shorefront home. You’ll never want to leave this airy, spacious, light-filled house, with its breathtaking views of Southwest Harbor and beyond on one side and its wall of French doors opening to a large granite patio on the other. Four bedrooms, three and half baths, screened in porch, hot tub, propane fire pit, and dock. It's time to relax! Cook lobster or a three-star gourmet dinner in a chef’s kitchen with top-end appliances, two sinks, and a wine fridge. Sip drinks on the porches, deck, or out on the spacious dock, paddle the three kayaks across the harbor, row to lunch in the dinghy, take the bicycles out for a spin, or play boules, ping pong, or badminton in the back garden. Have a water taxi pick you up at the deep-water dock and take you to Northeast Harbor for lunch or Little Cranberry Island for a gallery walk and dinner. (Better yet, bring your own boat and dock at our mooring, right in front of the house!)

The house features a curated collection of books, paintings, pottery, and sculptures by artists from Maine and beyond, and furniture that is a tasteful blend of vintage and contemporary pieces. 

In inclement weather, read a thriller on the cozy screened-in porch; settle in on a couch in front of the granite hearth; binge-watch a series on one of our flat-screen TVs; play piano on the upright piano; or choose a board game or puzzle from an extensive collection. Use the high-speed internet to work at one of five dedicated study/work areas. Enjoy the Sonos sound system and voice-activated assistant. 

In the evenings at home, gather for dinner in the comfortable dining room before sitting around the gas fire pit in Adirondack chairs, gazing at the sweeping views of the harbor and the sun setting over mountains and sea. Before bed, soak in the hot tub or one of two jacuzzis. Fall asleep on luxury thread count bedding, with pillows to fit every need.

Take a scenic 1.7 mile bike ride to Seawall, or ride a little farther to the easy walking trails of Wonderland or Ships Harbor. For a bit more exercise, choose from 22 great hiking trails within 9 miles. Enjoy the many shops and restaurants in the bucolic village center of Southwest Harbor, 1.3 miles from the house — and check out the Claremont Hotel, with its three restaurants, two bars, and day spa. Don’t forget to have lunch or dinner (or a blueberry martini!) at the world-famous Thurston’s Lobster Pound in Bernard, 4 miles from our door. [The space] There's plenty of room to park! Local sights, restaurants, and bars are within easy access, including Acadia National Park. [Guest access]

This spacious home offers an ideal getaway for families, friends & groups looking for comfort, convenience & breathtaking surroundings. Enjoy hiking, sunset views, kayaking on the cove, birdwatching & firepit s'mores. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, we have everything you need for a perfect getaway. Lee by the Sea Cottage **Brand New Rental in 2025 - Year-round Rental: See Acadia in all Seasons** Our family has been renting homes near Acadia National Park every summer for the last 35+ years before finally buying in 2024, and we have tried to include everything in the home that we would have wanted as renters (while still ensuring it is relaxing and cozy). Please reach out with any questions! Quick Highlights: • proximity to Mount Desert Island (10min drive), Bar Harbor (20min), Acadia National Park (20min), Ellsworth (8min) • waterfront & private beach/water access/water & sunset views • super fast fiber optic wifi • fully-stocked chef's kitchen (w/ lobster pot & tools) • free parking for 5+ cars • pet-friendly (bowls, medium crate, gate, dog bed) • smart TV • full house AC/heat: mini-split air conditioning and heat units in all bedrooms and open living area (plus backup radiant baseboard heat throughout) • BBQ & firepit, lots of outdoor furniture • yard, beach, deck, patio, and screened-in porch • washer/dryer/dishwasher • 2 kayaks available for use • 100% cotton, hotel-quality linens • three designated work spaces (2 sets of monitors, keyboards, computer mice) • brand new high-quality hybrid mattresses (comfy furniture throughout) • located on cove with lots of birds & wildlife (eagles, herons, seals, etc.) • family-friendly entertainment & amenities (children's toys, mini arcade, puzzles/board games, outdoor games, books for the whole family) • blackout curtains & noise machines in all bedrooms (for your convenience) • pack 'n play, high chair, jogger stroller, children's utensils More Details on the Key Features and Amenities: • Prime Waterfront Location (with Sunset View): Nestled on the serene shores of Mill Cove, offering stunning views and easy water access. The house sits atop a grassy hill, with a stone and sand beach below. House faces west for gorgeous nightly sunsets. • Spacious & Flexible Accommodations: Four bedrooms, three set up with king-sized beds and one with two twin xl beds. Each bedroom can be arranged as a king bed or two twin xl beds. This setup ensures flexible accommodations for different types of groups and restful nights for every guest. Bedroom linens are all hotel-quality, and each room comes equipped with robes for guests’ enjoyment during their stay. Three bedrooms have water views and three include desks for guests wishing to work remotely. • Three Full Bathrooms: Conveniently equipped with modern fixtures, making it easy for everyone to refresh and relax after a day of adventure. Hair dryers in each bathroom and high-quality bathroom towels and beach towels. • Fully Equipped Kitchen: Cook up your favorite meals in a fully equipped kitchen featuring modern appliances (including a dishwasher), cookware, and ample counter space. Coffee maker and Keurig included, as well as a popover pan and lobster pot/crackers for the perfect Maine meal. • Expansive Outdoor Deck, Stone Patio & Covered/Screened-In Porch: Enjoy breathtaking, panoramic views of Mill Cove, perfect for morning coffee, sunset dinners, or stargazing. • Outdoor Fire Pit: Gather around for s'mores and storytelling under the stars. • BBQ Grill: Savor fresh-cooked meals outdoors with the convenience of a top-notch grill. • High-Speed Wi-Fi: Stay connected for remote work or entertainment during your getaway; the house is connected to high-speed fiber optic wi-fi, perfect for video calls. • Smart TV: Relax and unwind with access to all your favorite streaming services. • Washer & Dryer: Perfect for longer stays or cleaning up after outdoor adventures. • Kayaks Included: Explore the calm waters of Mill Cove with two provided Old Town sea kayaks, perfect for paddling enthusiasts. Three adult-sized life jackets are also provided. • Pet-Friendly: Bring along your furry friends for the adventure (with prior approval & pet fee). • Birdwatching & Nature: Observe eagles, herons, ducks, and other coastal birds right from the deck, yard, or the large picture windows indoors (binoculars provided). On occasion, you may catch seals exploring the protected cove. • Ample Parking: Space for many cars, with a two-car covered garage. • Family-friendly: Children will love playing in the tidepools, swimming in the protected cove, or nature-watching at the property. A pack n’ play, highchair, and plenty of books and games are provided for rainy days. Perfect for Exploring Mount Desert Island and Acadia National Park: Located just a 10-minute drive from Mount Desert Island (use Goose Cove Road), this home is an ideal base for exploring the natural wonders of Acadia National Park (20 min away), quaint small towns of Bar Harbor (20 min away) and Ellsworth (8 min away), and the surrounding areas. Enjoy hiking, biking, kayaking, whale watching, and other outdoor activities, all while returning to a serene and comfortable home. Layout First Floor: The first floor of Lee by the Sea is designed for convenience and comfort, featuring a cozy bedroom with a king-sized bed and a large window with water views, perfect for guests preferring main-level accommodations. A full bathroom is located nearby, equipped with a separate shower and soaking bathtub, offering ease and accessibility. The heart of the home includes a fully equipped kitchen with high-end stainless steel appliances and plenty of counter space, seamlessly connecting to the dining room (with seating for eight) for shared meals. The spacious living room provides comfortable seating with a brand-new couch and large ottoman, reclining chair, rocking chair, accent chairs, a smart TV, and large windows that fill the space with natural light. For a touch of serenity, the sunroom offers a tranquil space with comfy seating to relax, read, birdwatch, or enjoy views of the peaceful Mill Cove. Second Floor: Upstairs, the second floor features three additional bedrooms, two outfitted with luxurious king-sized beds and one with two twin xl beds. Ample natural light and water views create private and restful retreats. All three bedrooms on this floor also include desks for guests who wish to work remotely. The primary bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom for added convenience, while the remaining two bedrooms share a second full bathroom, designed with modern amenities for comfort. This upper level offers a perfect balance of privacy and functionality, ideal for families or groups looking to unwind in a serene coastal setting. *Note: Brand new hybrid, high-quality mattresses have been purchased for all bedrooms. In addition, all four bedrooms can be set up with either one king size bed in the room or two separate twin size beds (beds are split kings that are able to be separated for two beds, if all guests would like their own, separate bed—or be joined, creating a king-size bed). We offer linens and bedding to accommodate either setup. This allows for flexibility in all bedrooms. Outside: The first floor leads out to an open deck and wrap-around covered and screened-in porch. Stairs lead from the open deck to a stone patio on the water’s edge. Outdoor furniture includes a dining table, outdoor couch, wicker furniture, and accent chairs. Around the patio (and the rest of the house) is a large grassy area – from the back of the house, an easy brick pathway leads down to the sandy shore on Mill Cove. There is also a gas grill, firepit, and 2 kayaks for use by guests. There is parking in the driveway to accommodate many cars and a two-car garage. Next door to the property is a small, historic family cemetery dating back to the civil-war era (these small plots are common throughout Trenton and Mount Desert Island). A Pinetown Collective stay in Downeast Maine

Fall in Maine is made for gathering. Bring the family, meet up with old friends, or finally plan that weekend everyone keeps talking about at Morancy Pond House—a spacious 7-bedroom, 4-bath waterfront retreat with room for 16.

Spend the day exploring Acadia, Schoodic and the villages of Downeast Maine, then come back to the pond for dinner together, quiet evenings by the water and nowhere else you need to be.

There's room here to gather—and room to spread out when you've had enough gathering.

The House at Morancy Pond is a spacious three-level waterfront home in Sullivan, Maine, with room for up to 16 guests. Designed for families and groups traveling together, the home offers multiple living areas, 7 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, beautiful pond views, and plenty of space to gather without feeling crowded.

Outside, enjoy direct access to Morancy Pond with 2 kayaks, 2 adult bikes, 2 children's bikes, a large deck overlooking the water, and a firepit for evenings outside.

The home is spread across three floors—the main floor, upstairs, and a fully finished walkout basement. Mini-split systems provide heating and air conditioning throughout the home for year-round comfort.

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements
9 total beds: 1 king, 3 queens, 3 doubles and 2 twins across seven bedrooms.

Upstairs
• Primary suite with king bed, lake views, walk-in closet, and en-suite bathroom with jacuzzi tub
• Three additional bedrooms with closets
• Full shared bathroom with tub

Main Floor
• Bedroom with queen bed
• Full bathroom with walk-in shower

Walkout Basement
• Two bedrooms
• Full bathroom with walk-in shower

🏡 The Heart of the House
The open kitchen, dining and living area is where everyone can come together. Large windows and doors overlook Morancy Pond and lead to the deck—perfect for slow mornings with coffee, big meals after a day exploring, or simply hanging out with your people.

🎮 Room to Spread Out
The finished walkout basement gives larger groups a second place to relax, with a comfortable TV living room, foosball, two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and washer and dryer.

It's especially nice when you're traveling with multiple families or generations: everyone can be together without having to be together every minute.

🌊 Life on Morancy Pond
Start the morning with a paddle, take your coffee down by the water, or spend an evening around the firepit. Morancy Pond gives you a quiet home base while still putting the coast, Acadia and the villages of Downeast Maine within reach.

📍 Explore Downeast Maine
• Acadia National Park — approximately 45 minutes
• Mount Desert Island & Bar Harbor — approximately 45 minutes
• Schoodic Peninsula — explore the quieter side of Acadia and drive the beautiful Maine coastline
• Bangor — approximately 1 hour
• Downeast Maine's coastal towns and villages

Whether you're gathering the family, meeting up with old friends, planning a reunion or just looking for enough room to bring everyone along, The House at Morancy Pond gives you the space to be together—and enough space to spread out.

Welcome to The Lobster Cottage, a private coastal retreat in beautiful Lamoine, Maine. Set on five wooded acres and tucked away from the road, the cottage offers the perfect balance of privacy, space, and easy access to the best of Downeast Maine.

Located just 25 minutes from Acadia National Park and Bar Harbor, you can spend the day exploring rocky coastlines, mountain trails, and charming coastal towns before returning to your own private retreat. Lamoine State Park is just ¼ mile away, and Lamoine Beach is only ½ mile away, making it easy to enjoy the water, sunsets, and quiet beauty right outside your door.

Designed with families and groups in mind, The Lobster Cottage comfortably sleeps up to 16 guests with 10 beds across multiple levels, giving everyone plenty of room to gather together or find their own space.

The Space

The cottage features a spacious, multi-level layout with everything you need for a comfortable Maine getaway.

Upper Level
-Gourmet kitchen
-Dining area
-Comfortable living room
-Primary bedroom with king bed and private bathroom
-Bedroom 2 with double bed
-Full bathroom
-Laundry

Lower Level
-Second kitchen and dining area
-Living room/Den
-Two guest bedrooms, each with a queen and twin bed
-Additional sleeping area with two double beds and two twin beds
-Full bathroom

The lower level is especially well suited for families and groups, with its own kitchen, dining area, family room, bedrooms, and additional sleeping space. The bunk area is located adjacent to the family room.

With multiple gathering spaces, two kitchens, and plenty of sleeping options, the cottage is designed so large groups can comfortably vacation together without feeling crowded.

Welcome to the Black Seal Chalet in Southwest Harbor, ME! A brand new build in 2026, this 2,100 sq ft chalet is located on a quiet, walkable circle very close to town, trails & beaches. There's even a local lobsterman who sells his catch daily just up the street. 

Downstairs has 2 king bedrooms, 1 queen bedroom with an office area, and a full bathroom(shower & tub). Upstairs has a king bedroom, and a full bathroom(shower only). Each bedroom has it's own thoughtfully decorated theme, window shades/curtains, closet, dresser, luggage stand, bedside tables/lamps, ceiling fans and 32" Roku TV. All beds have comfortable hybrid mattresses, extra pillows and high quality cotton linens.

The loft overlooks the downstairs living area. A game table is ready for board games, cards and puzzles or relax in the lounge area perfect for reading or taking a nap. 

The spacious living area allows in tons of natural light via multiple windows and 2 sliders providing access to the large deck. Enjoy the 65" Roku TV with Hulu and Disney+ streaming included. Relax on the large comfortable sectional, or by the gas fireplace in one of the 2 cozy armchairs. Additionally there are 2 ottomans, a ceiling fan and dimmable lights. 

The custom kitchen is ready for foodies and bakers! Prepare a meal for your friends and family while they hang out at the large island. Cabinets are stocked with all the essential cooking and baking utensils, pots, pans, bakeware, ample dinnerware, cups, mugs, wine/cocktail glasses and kid's dinnerware. The kitchen also features stainless steel appliances, a coffee/tea station, cocktail area and beverage fridge. In addition to seating for 3 at the island, there is a separate dining table that seats 6. 

On the main floor is a utility room with washer, dryer, and a tub sink. The mudroom has hooks for coats and bags, storage for boots and shoes, a bench and a side table. Off the mudroom, a closet contains a high chair and a pack'n'play crib for families with little ones, as well as extra camp chairs, and a cooler for use outdoors or at the beach. 

Outside you will be surrounded by 2 secluded acres of pines, maples and more. Enjoy watching birds and neighborhood deer go by while listening to the sound of the breeze in the trees as you lounge on the deck. Outdoor furnishings include Adirondack chairs, a glider, a sun lounger and an outdoor dining table. Grill on the propane BBQ, and spend your evenings around the fire pit enjoying great conversations, camp stories and sing-alongs.  

Located on the "Quiet Side" of Mount Desert Island, the Black Seal is in the perfect location for all types of stays. Oceanfront and just minutes from Acadia, Harbor & Pine is a relaxed coastal cottage in Prospect Harbor with unbelievable views, salty air, and the quiet charm of Maine’s working waterfront. Spend your days exploring the shoreline, watching lobster boats drift through the harbor, and unwinding in a place that feels comfortably lived in and deeply connected to the coast. Welcome to Harbor & Pine — a relaxed oceanfront cottage on Prospect Harbor in Gouldsboro, Maine, where the views feel almost unreal and the pace of life slows down the moment you arrive.

Located on Maine's Schoodic Peninsula, Harbor & Pine offers easy access to Acadia National Park's spectacular mainland section, where rugged granite shorelines, crashing surf, scenic overlooks, and coastal hiking trails await — without the crowds of Bar Harbor. Many visitors consider Schoodic one of Acadia's best-kept secrets, offering the same breathtaking beauty with a quieter, more authentic coastal Maine experience.

3 bedrooms, 2 baths:
🛌 Main Floor King Bedroom (take note: Main Floor, no-step access)
🛁 Main Floor Full Bathroom
🛌🛁 2nd Floor King Suite with Bathroom
🛌🛌 2x Queen Beds

Set along the rugged Downeast coastline just minutes from Acadia National Park, this comfortable waterfront cottage was made for guests who want to experience the quieter, more authentic side of coastal Maine. Here, mornings begin with coffee overlooking the harbor, salty air drifting through the windows, and lobster boats heading out across the water. Evenings end with sunsets, stargazing, and the peaceful rhythm of the working harbor below.

The scenery here is hard to put into words — and honestly, the photos don’t fully capture it. The coastline changes by the hour with the tides, weather, boats, fog, and light. It’s the kind of place people stand quietly for a moment when they first walk outside.

The home comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests with 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including a private second-floor king suite and an additional king bedroom and full bath on the main floor for easy accessibility and comfortable main-level living.

Inside, the cottage feels welcoming and relaxed — thoughtfully prepared for guests to settle in and feel at home after long days exploring the coast. Large windows pull the ocean views indoors, while the surrounding pines and rocky shoreline give the home that unmistakable Maine cottage feeling.

Prospect Harbor itself is still a real working harbor, home to fishing boats, quiet roads, and one of Maine’s beautiful lighthouses nearby. It feels peaceful, grounded, and deeply connected to the coast.

Whether you're hiking Acadia, taking scenic drives along the shoreline, eating fresh lobster on a picnic table, or simply staying put to enjoy the view, Harbor & Pine is the kind of place that invites you to slow down and stay awhile.

31185398.desc:
Come stay the night in the gorgeous Harbor View rental in Southwest Harbor, Maine! Harbor View is located just minutes outside of downtown Southwest Harbor on a hill overlooking the picturesque port that gives the town its name. Watch the local lobster-fishermen leave the harbor beneath the Maine sunrise or maybe a refreshing cold beverage on the spacious deck while admiring the view of Cranberry Islands. Harbor View can host eleven guests, making it a perfect getaway for multiple families.  Several TVs and gathering spaces make for wonderful nights together enjoying games, cards, or movies. The incredible location of Harbor View, in what is known as “The Quietside” of Mount Desert Island, is possibly the largest advantage of the property. Southwest Harbor used to be a small fishing village and retains a vibrant small-town fishing community. Enjoy a cup of tea or coffee while watching local lobster-fishermen leave the harbor beneath a Maine sunrise or maybe a refreshing cold beverage while admiring the view of Cranberry Islands.  A five minute walk to downtown Southwest Harbor allows you to spend time exploring local restaurants and shops on foot. The free Island Explorer bus stops in town so you can easily travel to almost anywhere on the Island hassle free! The Quietside is packed with some of Acadia National Park’s most beautiful hiking trails and views, including the famous Bass Harbor Lighthouse, as well as the gorgeous waters of Long Pond and Echo Lake, which are perfect for swimming during warm summer months. Harbor View is a mere fifteen minute drive from downtown Bar Harbor, which allows you close enough proximity to the bustling crowds, restaurants and shops there, yet a close enough distance to escape back to the quieter side away from the chaotic cruise ship population. Southwest Harbor provides its own opportunities for both private boat rentals, fishing tours on the untouched waters in the Gulf of Maine or day trips to the outer islands. 
	
The core of the house itself was built in the 1920s and retains the historic style of the era while recent additions to the space include an additional second level to seamlessly blend modern living with historic building design. The first floor consists of a kitchen with all the necessary items, a living/gathering room, as well as two bedrooms; one with a twin and a bunkbed and one with a double bed. The living room displays wonderful panoramic views of the Harbor through windows that illuminate the entire downstairs in natural light. The upstairs has another living/gathering space of its own, equipped with a TV and sleeper sofa. Two additional bedrooms finish off this lovely space and allow for optimal comfort. The views from the master are unbeatable anywhere else in the home.  The sprawling deck allows for beautiful inside/outside living and offers you a close up look of the unspoiled views. 

Peak season is June 15 through September 15 and requires a seven night stay [The space]

The perfect home base for your Downeast Maine adventure. Mainstay Cottage comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests and features a king primary suite with private deck and en-suite bath, a second bedroom with a full bed and twin daybed with trundle, a cozy twin sleeping nook with water views, and a private fireplace room with a double pullout sofa. Guests enjoy two full bathrooms, a fully stocked kitchen, indoor and outdoor dining, waterfront outdoor spaces, three kayaks, a fire pit, lawn games, and a basement game room with pool table, darts, Pepper Pong, puzzles, and board games.

A spacious retreat featuring a king bed, en-suite bath with jacuzzi tub and handheld shower, cozy wood-burning stove, and private deck.

One full bed plus a daybed with twin trundle, providing flexible sleeping arrangements for families.

The twin "window seat" nook offers arguably the best view in the house. A cozy spot to curl up with a book by day and a unique sleeping space by night.

* Solo Stove fire pit

* Three single kayaks

---

Game Room

---

Location

Located near the head of Taunton Bay, the property offers beautiful coastal scenery and ever-changing tidal landscapes. Come & stay for a unique experience w/ stunning views of Somes Sound.. Vacation home with 3 BR, 4 Baths, expansive picture windows, internet, patio, aircondition / heat pumps, EV charger, wharf & dock, W&D, and complimentary kayaks. 

See eagles, seals,wild fowls & other wildlife.  Enjoy sunsets, moonrises or stargaze from the dock. Hiking trails, Echo Lake, & Long Pond 7 mins. DT Bar Harbor & SW Harbor 12 mins. Come and stay for a unique experience of Somes Sound Harbor. The Sound is the only fjard in the East coast. This fjard runs  deep into Mount Desert Island, the main site of Acadia National Park. See eagles, wild fowls & other wildlife right at your backyard. Complimentary kayaks & life vests  are available to explore the Harbor. Enjoy sunrise, moonrises or stargaze from the dock. 

Located in Somesville at Mount Desert Island right in the middle of everything Acadia National National Park has to offer, with convenient access to Bar Harbor, SW Harbor & NE Harbor (13-15 mins drive). The house is in a National Historic District in between the Somesville Library & The Gallery at Somes Sound. The Somesville Museum & Gardens is right across the street. There are multiple hiking trails close by.

You can't get any closer to the water than this. The waterfront is tidal which is awesome. On high tide the ocean water is about 5 feet from the house. High tide is about 8-12 feet high. Low tide is perfect for beach exploration. 

This is a 3 level house with 3 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bath. The fourth full bathroom is located on the main level.  There are two master bedrooms located respectively on the upper and lower levels of the house. Each with king size beds. The second bedroom in the upper level  has two queen beds. This waterfront vacation home offers unforgettable views of Somes Harbor with its backdrop mountains of Acadia National Park. The backyard also features a private wharf with  gangway to the floating dock. 

Located right in the middle of the Historic Village of Somesville. The house is located between the Somesville Library and the Gallery at Somes Sound. Across the street to the left side is the historic Somesville Museum & Gardens with the famous picturesque Somesville wooden walk bridge. Very conveniently located for exploring Acadia National Park and Bar Harbor. Mill Pond is on the right side of the house. During Spring, Alewives (fish) would swarm under the private wharf waiting for the tide to be high enough for them to swim to the fish ladder towards Mill Pond, then to Somes Pond.  The beautiful Echo Lake with its sandy beach and Long Pond which is perfect for kayaking & stand up paddle boarding are just 5-7 minutes from the house .

The Upper Level of this vacation home features two bedrooms. The master bedroom has an expansive picture window of the Somes. The Master Bedroom features king size bed, ensuite bath (walk in shower, vanity, toilet), smart tv, and comfortable power Leather Italia loveseat. The second bedroom has  queen beds and an en-suite bath (walk in shower, vanity, toilet). 

The Lower Level Master bedroom has an open concept design. This bedroom is accessed via the main level with full flight of stairs with rail on the left upon coming down. It has sliding glass door that exits to the waterfront where the private wharf and dock are located. This room features, a beautiful picture window with seating for three. There is an entertainment area with power reclining Leather Italia loveseat to view the smart TV. The  full bath  features a free standing bath tub, vanity sink, & toilet. This lower level also houses the laundry room with one washer and two dryers. 

The main floor (level with the parking area) features the living room with comfortable oversized 2 leather loveseats and 1 sofa. Sit back and enjoy our 75 inch smart TV. Dine and enjoy the Harbor view  through the wide picture window . Breakfast nook has seating for 3 and the dining table with seating for 5. The kitchen has full size appliances: fridge, stove top oven, dishwasher, counter top microwave, toaster, coffee maker, and blender. 

The house is four seasons. During the cooler months of the year the house has two sources of heat  (late Fall, Winter, Early Spring). The house features heat pumps with Air-condition (Summer) / Heating features and  electric baseboard heaters.   

The backyard features propane fire pit with comfortable  polywood Adirondock chairs. A private wharf  with gangway to the float for easy access to the water. The waterfront is tidal. There's complimentary Kayaks. There are life vests for guest to use. They are complimentary.  The wharf has outdoor dining table with seating for 8 with the propane fired grill right next to it.

The property can  park two vehicles parallel to each other. No room for a third vehicle. We have an EV charger that can be used with a fee.

This house was designed with guest comfort in mind.

"The Wells " is a true 3 season getaway. Tucked at the waters edge on 15 acres, you truly feel you have escaped into your own little piece of Maine paradise. The house is situated on the edge of serene West Bay with views of the water throughout. 2 private decks and a large screened in porch a fire pit and a shirt walk to the waters edge make for easy summer living. There is no AC, but we have provided numerous fans throughout, [The space] The garage and loft above are not available for guest use . [Guest access] Like many Maine homes, we do not have AC. We provide plenty of fans and ample windows allow for fresh bay breezes. There is a ceiling fan in the master.

We have found it typically resolves within the hour but must disclose that it has happened on a couple occasions. If this does not resolve the issue you can  contact us we can try to assist in timely restoration. [Other things to note]

✔ This Historic Home Was The Island's General Store & Butcher Shop, Dating Back To 1856

✔ 5 min to Acadia National Park

✔ Somes Sound Brook In Your Backyard

✔ 7-Person Hot Tub Under String Lights 

✔ Kayaking & Swimming In Somes Sound, Long Pond & Echo Lake

✔ Fire Pit, Grill, & Lobster Pot

✔ Theater With Real Reclining Theater Seats & Movie Candy Provided

✔ All Dogs Welcome

✔ Air Conditioning, Fast Wifi, Washer/ Historic 1856 Retreat with Theater Room, Hot Tub & Steps to Acadia National Park

This isn't just a vacation rental—it's a piece of Maine history. 

Built in 1856 and once home to Mount Desert's original general store and butcher shop, this meticulously restored Main Street property blends authentic historic character with modern comforts for an experience you won't find anywhere else.

Sleep among preserved store counters and vintage safes, soak in the hot tub overlooking Somes Sound inlet, watch movies in your private theater, and explore Acadia National Park just moments from your door.

WHAT MAKES THIS HOME SPECIAL

✔ Historic 1856 building with original general store & butcher shop preserved

✔ Private theater room with 6 leather recliners & surround sound

✔ Game room with air hockey, 9-foot shuffleboard, games, & 70" Smart TV

✔ 7-person hot tub overlooking the stream and historic fish ladder

✔ Minutes to Acadia National Park, Jordan Pond & Cadillac Mountain

✔ Sleeps up to 14 in uniquely historic spaces, 3 stories in total

THE SPACE

The original general store and butcher shop have been transformed into spaces you'll never forget. 

The game room preserves historic details while hosting full-size air hockey, 9-foot shuffleboard, a comfortable sectional, and a 70" Smart TV for streaming. 

Next door, your private theater room features six leather recliners, big-screen viewing with surround sound, and complimentary movie candy—because every great movie needs snacks.

Outside, your backyard borders the inlet of Somes Sound with the historic fish ladder steps away. 

Sink into the 7-person hot tub under the stars with the sound of flowing water nearby, lounge on the daybed overlooking the stream, gather around the fire pit for s'mores and stories, or fire up the propane grill and lobster pot for a classic Maine feast at the outdoor dining table.

Inside, the fully equipped kitchen handles everything from quick breakfasts to big lobster dinners with modern appliances, ample counter space, and gadgets like an Instant Pot and crock pot. For coffee enthusiasts, we have a Keurig Duo that brews both pods and a carafe. 

The open living and dining area brings everyone together with comfortable leather seating, a Smart TV, and a dining table that seats the whole crew. 

Large windows flood the space with natural light and connect you to the historic charm all around.

WHERE EVERYONE SLEEPS

2 king suites with private en-suite bathrooms, brand-new mattresses, 50" Smart TVs

1 main-floor queen bedroom with 50" Smart TV

1 twin bedroom with 2 twin beds, 50" Smart TV

Historic General Store Room: 3 king beds set among preserved original features, including the old store counter and safe—a guest favorite and truly unforgettable experience

Four full bathrooms throughout: main-floor tub/shower combo, upper-floor walk-in shower, lower-level walk-in shower, and lower-level king suite with clawfoot soaking tub.

Provided For Your Stay: We provide all linens, bath towels (Beach towels not provided), and basic soaps. A full-size washer and dryer are also in the unit for your convenience.

For Families: A Pack 'n Play, high chair, and baby gate are available for your use.

IMPORTANT NOTE ABOUT THIS HISTORIC HOME

This property was built in 1856 and lovingly preserved. You'll find original elements like steep stairs, uneven floors, and imperfect paint—these are part of the home's authentic character and charm. 

If you're looking for a modern, cookie-cutter rental, this isn't it. 

If you want a one-of-a-kind historic experience with stories in every room, you've found your place.

Other things to note....

Guest Access

Guests will have private and exclusive access to the entire home and its property. This includes all interior spaces, the outdoor deck, the private 7-person hot tub, the fire pit area, and the yard. Your Acadia retreat is all yours to enjoy with the convenience of a private entrance and seamless self-check-in via a secure smart lock.

Interaction With Guests

Here at Waves & Wilderness, we respect your privacy and will not be on-site during your stay, allowing you to fully relax and enjoy your vacation. However, we are always available and responsive via the messaging app to answer any questions or provide local recommendations to make your stay memorable.

This brand-new home sleeps 18 in 6 bedrooms, including a bunk room with 4 twin-over-twin bunks, plus a great room with fireplace, dining for 14 and a kitchen with 2 ovens. Quiet and private, yet close to all of Mount Desert Island. Welcome to your Acadia escape — a spacious, beautifully crafted new home tucked into the woods and just steps from the Carriage Roads and the boundary of Acadia National Park. Designed for large families, multi‑family trips, and group getaways, this brand‑new home blends modern comfort with the quiet, timeless feel of Maine’s forests.

With room for up to 18 guests, multiple gathering spaces, and direct access to the park, this is the perfect home base for exploring Acadia, Bar Harbor, and the rugged beauty of Mount Desert Island.

Walk out the back door and right into Acadia National Park! You are also just a quick 12 min drive right into downtown Bar Harbor, a 1 mile walk to Seal Harbor Beach, or a mile walk or bike ride to the infamous Jordan Pond House! Enjoy the perfect location away from it all with quick access to the highlights of Mount Desert Island. If you don't feel like leaving the house, you can enjoy looking at the park and watching the horses go by on the Carriage Road right from the deck or Great Room.

The is a large home with every amenity you could hope for. With one queen bedroom and full bath on the main floor, four bedrooms and two baths on the second floor, and a giant bunk room and full bath in the finished daylight basement there is plenty of room for your whole family. 

Enjoy relaxing in front of a fire in the spacious great room that features a beautiful wood paneled vault ceiling and quiet views into Acadia National Park.

If you don't want to spend your time eating indoors, take advantage of the large grill and enjoy dinner on the large deck looking into the park. The front porch is the perfect spot for a quiet cup of coffee or listening to the ocean during a storm.

Relax with the whole family at this peaceful retreat! Summer Harbor Cabin is located in the quaint village of Winter Harbor with coastal views of Cadillac Mountain and minutes from Schoodic Point. 

Board the Winter Harbor Ferry to reach Bar Harbor and Mt Desert Island with ease.

A perfect location for anyone wishing to enjoy the quieter side of Acadia National Park, while staying close to great food, hiking, biking, and kayaking!

See “Other things” for more details about park accessibility. Hand built by a fourth-generation lobsterman, this house is a one-of-a-kind experience. We welcome you to enjoy a beautiful view of Acadia National Park and Egg Rock lighthouse, while enjoying all the amenities of our home away from home. 

We strive to offer you a natural, holistic atmosphere in all aspects. We use all non-toxic cleaning products and detergents, and we have a four-stage Aquasana water filtration system with a UV light that filters the water throughout the home. 

We welcome dogs at the house and have food bowls ready for your use. Unfortunately, due to allergies, we can’t allow cats in the house. 

Please note that the home is elevated for the benefit of an amazing view! There is a flight of steps to enter the first floor. 

Kitchen & Dining 
Whip up a hearty breakfast before your hike, or enjoy a lobster feast at the end of your day of adventures. Our kitchen is fully equipped for cooking meals for your family or group! Our dining table seats 8 comfortably, overlooking the view. 

Basement & Laundry
A walk-out basement offers a mud room area for gear, washer and dryer, a slop sink and prep area (perfect for prepping seafood!), and a game table for rainy-day cards or puzzles. 

A set of Bowflex adjustable weights and workout mat can be found here as well. 

Bedrooms
Enjoy a second-floor master bedroom with a King bed and sitting area. Wake up to a beautiful coastal view and enjoy a morning brew from your own private coffee setup. 

Also on the second floor is a half bath, and a second bedroom with a bunk bed and a Queen bed overlooking our deep Maine woods outback. 

On the first floor, adjacent to a full bath, is a large bedroom with a Queen bed and workspace. Here you will find a printer, desk, and basic office supplies. 

Outdoors  
We invite you to once again enjoy the coastal view and breezes under shade outside, where we have a grill, picnic table, and Adirondack chairs. 

There is an oversized fire pit area with built in benches surrounding it. Relax beside a campfire in the cooler Maine evenings under the stars. 

An outdoor shower is available as well! [The space] Enjoy Summer Harbor Cabin as if it was your home away from home! [Guest access] Acadia National Park on Mount Desert Island (MDI) is about an hour drive from the house.

Another way to reach the island is to board the Winter Harbor ferry (Downeast Windjammer Cruises) just down the road. Enjoy a scenic and informational ride to Bar Harbor, where you can then utilize the Island Explorer buses to access the park. 

The beautiful Schoodic Peninsula is a part of Acadia National Park on the mainland. The entrance is 2 miles down the road! It is a quieter experience with fewer crowds, still known for its dramatic granite coastline, stunning ocean views and hiking trails. We love the accessibility of Schoodic, as it allows you to stop in and out frequently throughout your stay, even if you just want to grab your dinner and head into the park to catch the sunset! 

Feel free to check us out and interact on social to see additional photos, videos, and local recommendations! @summerharborcabin [Other things to note]

Nautic  Bay, a classic Maine cottage on a bluff that offers surreal  views of the water amidst a backdrop  of the Cadillac and Sargent Mountains with its changing tides. Located 20-25 mins. to downtown Bar Harbor & Acadia National Park Visitor Center. The house sits on 5.5 acres with 525 ft of gravel & mud beach front. We have another vacation home  located next to this house. It can be rented together accommodating up to 15 guests. Both homes has its own driveway, parking for multiple vehicles, back yard,  & stairs to the beach. 

The house sits on a bluff with great views of the Western Bay Cove & the mountains of Acadia. It accommodates 8 guests providing 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths on the main level. 4th bedroom is accessed via soft stairs to a private loft not visible from the main level. 

The first level features a wrap around deck with outdoor seating overlooking the ocean. The deck hugs half of the house. The  dining area has direct access to the deck. A fully stocked kitchen. Two full baths. Master bedroom has comfortable king size bed, en-suite bath, & closet. Two other bedrooms has queen size beds and walk in closets. One of bedroom with queen bed offers a nice ocean view.  All 3 bedrooms on the main level has smart TV's.

Living room features a comfortable  sofa, love seat and a swivel oversized chair to enjoy our giant 86 inch smart TV. 

Dining table seats 8. Kitchen is fully stocked. Full size appliances includes fridge / freezer, electric oven / stove, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, drip carafe & k-cup coffee makers with complimentary start up coffee.

The 4th bedroom / loft is accessed via soft L shaped stairs offering privacy for its occupants at its location. It has twin over twin beds ( 38 inches wide, 75 inches long mattresses each). It offers 360 views of its surrounding via its small windows. Access to the upper twin bed is via safe side steps. 

Outdoor living, offers multiple areas. Wrap around deck has outdoor seating. Firewood fed fire pit has 3  twin wooden chairs surrounding it. We provide start up firewood with fire starting materials stored in a small plastic bin close to the pit. Fire pit is perfect for making s'mores and the unique experience of strong heat with crackling sound from the  burning wood. Further down towards the beach is another deck for al fresco outdoor dinning. It features a dining table,  6 chairs, and a propane fired grill. The steps to the beach are a little steep for most people. The dock is perfect for daytime reading, lounging, and stargazing. Welcome to your Maine and Acadia National Park retreat! Stunning water and Schoodic Mountain views through floor-to-ceiling windows!
Escape to The Maine House, a brand-new, all-seasons energy-efficient sanctuary designed for small groups, hikers, and nature adventurers. Built with Passive and Pretty Good House standards in mind, this bright, modern home provides a cozy, sustainable base for exploring the magic of Acadia National Park and the entire Down East Maine region any time of the year. Open-plan modern cabin design with 3 queen bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms with showers, and a twin bunk in a bed nook! All comforts for 8 people! Secluded but close to everything!

Experience the profound tranquility of the Acadia and Down East and the quaint charm of New England, while staying in our house designed to capture breathtaking, panoramic views of Egypt and Taunton Bay,  Schoodic Mountain, and the daily sunrise. Come for the region’s famous hikes and salted Summer, the  Fall colors leaf peeping, and the Winter cross country skiing.  Enjoy the easy going Acadia carriage roads or other adventures, warm up instantly with the woodstove's relaxing and intimate glow or hangout aroundthe fire pit with dinner from  the grill.  Recharge in the comfort of a warm and cozy home equipped with modern living amenities. Open the screened doors and turn the living room to a porch.

Perfect for observing the bay, Oskar - the resident seal, the mountain acrossthe bay, and many birds (we are in a special migratory birds protection area of the State of Maine) .

*If you want to  make outdoor fire at the firepit, for convenience, our neighbor,  Jarrod, has a stand on the property where you can get dry, good quality camp wood.

✦ Sleeping 22 guests, enjoy the trip of a lifetime on the Maine coast from your own private mansion next to Acadia NP and Bar Harbor - Built in 1828, we are one of the most prominent & historical homes in the region

✦ Amazing Amenities - heated pool, hot tub, full kitchen, 6 living rooms, 18+ dining table, firepit & lawn games, arcade games, 5 TV's, private gym, and uniquely designed

✦ We do host small weddings/events! Read below for info

✦ Free curated travel & activities guide with booking ✧ The Jarvis Homestead is a one-of-a-kind home, and was inducted into the National Registry of Historical places in 2004. It is professionally and beautifully designed, using local artifacts from all over the state of Maine. 

✧ For more info on us, info on events/weddings, and the history of the house, check out our website. Just type in Jarvis Homestead on the web.

✧ We can comfortably sleep 22 guests - 4 King beds, 5 Queen beds, and 5 Twin beds between 10 separate bedrooms. We can possibly host up to 25 guests total with an extra fee included. 

✧ We are also pet friendly!

 ✧ We are fully open and ready to book for all of 2026, 2027 and 2028. Please send us a message if interested. Please read below for more info, and head to the FAQ section below for more info on weddings/events.

✧ Only House Rule: No parties or loud noises outside after 9pm. You are more than welcome to continue the fun inside after dark!

-
-
-

▪▪▪▪▪ ABOUT US ▪▪▪▪▪

▪AMENTITIES▪
→  Built in 1828 and on the National Registry of Historical Places, the Jarvis Homestead is a beautifully designed, updated, comfortable and a massive home, consisting of 25 total rooms: 10 bedrooms, 6 living areas (including game room), a full and beautiful kitchen, 5 bathrooms (3 full, 2 half), a grand dining room (seats 18), a private gym, and a laundry room.

→  Our property is private and surrounded by the beautiful Maine nature, while still a 5 min walk to downtown. We have parking for 10 vehicles, a private outdoor pool (open late May - mid Oct), private 6-person hot tub (open year round), lawn space, propane firepit, outdoor sofa, massive dining table and lawn games. Everything mentioned is provided and free for guests to use.

▪MODERNIZED▪
→  The home is fully updated, modernized and comfortable for the whole group: Brand new AC & heating, fully stocked kitchen (everything you need), all brand new appliances (8-burner stove, two refrigerators, dishwasher, hot water heater, washer and dryer, wine fridge, coffee maker), high speed Wi-Fi in every room, comfortable beds, 5 flat screen smart TVs (all with streaming services), 6 working desks, 9 couches, 5 dining/eating areas, Xbox 1 console, arcade games, board games, large vintage gaming table (in game room), over 1,000 books (all kinds), authentic Maine décor and artifacts, grand piano, cozy faux fireplaces and candles, tons of closets and dressers, and much more.

▪NUMBER OF GUESTS▪
→  Even though Airbnb says 16+, our home can comfortably sleep up to 22 guests, and is the perfect getaway for all friends and family. We also hosts all types of events (up to 25 guests total on the property), although events services are up to the guest. Please read the FAQ section below for more.

▪HISTORY▪
→  On the National Registry of Historical Places, the Jarvis Homestead is one of the most prominent and unique homes in the Acadia region of Maine. Steeped in rich and interesting history, it has been home to several important and influential people to the state of Maine since the 1800's (Hannibal Hamlin Jr. - son of Abe Lincoln's Vice President). Completed with antique revival interior that portrays the designs of the 1800's, every room in the house includes authentic Maine artifacts and artwork.

▪AREA▪
→  We are within walking distance to downtown Ellsworth (4 min walk), which is an adorable town 20 mins from Acadia National Park, filled with shops, restaurants, museums and more. We are located in the heart of the Maine coastline, and very close to several famous coastal Maine destinations - Bar Harbor, Camden, Rockland, Bath, Bucksport, Castine and more! Come enjoy the unspoiled Maine coastline and wilderness from your own private mansion in Ellsworth, the gateway to Acadia National Park and the coastline of Maine.

-
-
-

▪▪▪▪▪ FAQ ▪▪▪▪▪

▪DO WE HOST WEDDINGS, EVENTS OR SHOWINGS?▪
→   Yes! We are not a dedicated wedding venue, but we love to see when people want to host their special day or event at our beautiful home. We will help in whatever way we can! However, we do not provide any wedding services, catering services, or equipment for the wedding or event.  Also a few things to consider:

→   We will not be able to host your event if you book through AirBnb due to AirBnb party policies. Please book through our private website to host an event. To find our website, type Jarvis Homestead into the web. Here you can find more wedding and event pricing and info.

→  We charge an extra fee for all events. Events are considered to be any type of weddings (big or small), having more than 22 people at the house at any time, and having outside furniture and/or rental equipment at the house. 

→   No dance floors are allowed inside or outside the home, moving furniture is not allowed, and the property must be left in the same condition as before the event. 

→   Quiet hours are after 9pm. Absolutely no loud music or noises after 9pm. Zero tolerance - If this rule is violated, guests will be asked to leave the house immediately. This applies to all guests.

 →   We allow a max of 25 people on the property, and a max of 22 to sleep at the house.

→    We are not a typical event venue, and are not licensed or insured to host large events past 9pm. However, we will work with you the best we can to host you for your event and make it special, so please work with us :) 



▪NUMBER OF GUESTS?▪
→    We can comfortably sleep up to 22 guests. We have a total of 8 queen beds, 1 full bed, and 5 twin beds. We have 3 full bathrooms upstairs, and 2 half bathrooms downstairs (one half bath is near pool and open in summer).


▪OPEN YEAR ROUND?▪
→    Absolutely! We are open to book 365 days of the year so guests can experience and enjoy every beautiful season that Maine has to offer.


▪POOL AND HOT TUB?▪
→    The hot tub is open year round.
→    The pool will usually open late May, and close in mid October, all dependent on weather. We will try our best to accommodate everyone’s needs on the pool. Please work with us while the pool is difficult to heat and maintain in colder weather. We try our best to have it open by late May (Memorial Day Weekend) but this is not guaranteed.
→    Also, due to large amount of propane needed, the pool is heated to 70-75 degrees. But is usually warmer (76-80) in July-Sep from the natural sunlight. If guests would like the pool warmer throughout their stay, please contact us during your stay.


▪FREE PARKING?▪
→    Yes! We have plenty of free parking on the property available to guests. The main driveway can accommodate up to 3-4 vehicles, and the back driveway can accommodate up to another 4-5 vehicles.


▪JARVIS HOMESTEAD TO ACADIA NATIONAL PARK?▪
→    The house is located in beautiful Ellsworth Maine, which is the gateway to the Downeast region and is about a 20 min drive from Bar Harbor and Acadia NP. Ellsworth is a quaint, lively community that is open year round and filled with shops, restaurants, breweries and activities, and gives travelers the chance to get out of the hustle and bustle of Bar Harbor and experience local Maine. Ellsworth is also very centrally located, and easily gives guests the opportunity to experience other world famous coastal Maine destinations like Rockland, Camden, Winter Harbor, Castine, Bath, Bucksport and more! Also, beautiful Baxter State Park is only 1.5 hours north of the Jarvis Homestead. Ellsworth is the right place to be to experience the untouched coast and wilderness of Maine at their fullest.


▪PETS?▪
→    Yes, we allow pets! All we ask is that you clean up after your furry friends and leave the house in the same condition as you checked in.


▪ARE TOILETRIES, COOKING SUPPLIES AND SHEETS PROVIDED?▪
→    Of course! We provide you with everything you will need during your vacation. Soap, shampoo, body wash, hair dryers, toilet paper and towels are all provided in each bathroom. Our kitchen will be fully stocked to cook for the entire family! 


▪KITCHEN SUPPLIES?▪
→    We have it all in the kitchen. This includes two refrigerators, gas stove (8-burner and double oven), 3 slow cookers, large bowls, kettle, drip coffee maker (with coffee provided), spices & oils, pots & pans, cups, silverware, plates & bowls, lobster utensils, barbecue utensils, mugs and more.


▪CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT TIMES?▪
→    To be able to provide our wonderful cleaners with enough time to prepare the house for every group, check-in is at 4pm and check-out is 10am.


▪AC AND HEATING?▪
→    Of course! We have a brand new mini-split ductless system that provides AC and Heating in every room of the house. Guests can select whatever temperature that fits their needs for each room specifically.


▪CRIBS AND HIGH CHAIRS?▪
→    We sure do. We provide two cribs, a pack-and-play and a high chair for your toddlers.


▪HOW MANY TV'S?▪
→    The house has a total of 5 flat screen smart TVs. All TVs have Netflix, Hulu and whatever streaming services you need! 
→    We also have an Xbox One in the loft game room with two controllers, a Mortal Kombat arcade game and a foldable basketball arcade game. We also provide an abundant amount of board games and books throughout the house.


▪DO THE FIREPLACES WORK?▪
→    We do have the authentic original fireplaces throughout the home, but due to safety reasons we have installed faux fireplaces that create the lights and sounds of a real burning wood fire!


▪FREE LAUNDRY?▪
→    Of course! We have a newer washer and dryer in the laundry room that guests have full access to. Detergent is provided.

-
-
-

▪▪▪▪▪ AREA - WHY ELLSWORTH? ▪▪▪▪▪

→    Yes, Bar Harbor gets all the hype. We know most people want to visit Acadia National Park, and you absolutely should! It is one of the most beautiful and amazing places in America. Ellsworth is the gateway to Acadia and Downeast Maine (coastal Maine) and provides very easy access to Acadia (20 min drive). Due to its central location, Ellsworth provides the best access to many other famous and beautiful coastal Maine towns, including Camden, Rockland, Winter Harbor, Bucksport, Belfast and Bath. You get the best of both worlds being in Ellsworth, having close proximity to Acadia and Bar Harbor, as well as access to other Maine towns and the wilderness.

→    Ellsworth has the local Maine charm and isn't packed with tourists. It is a quiet and peaceful home base. There are so many wonderful and affordable restaurants, gift shops, antique stores, lobster shacks (one right down the street from the house!), grocery stores, museums, breweries, wildlife sanctuary, and an L.L. Bean outlet in Ellsworth. The Downeast Scenic Railroad is stationed in Ellsworth, which consists of a beautiful train ride through the Maine wilderness. The Ellsworth area has an abundant amount of hiking, ATV trails, ponds (lakes), waterways and winter activities.

-
-
-

▪▪▪▪▪ YEAR ROUND ▪▪▪▪▪

→    The Jarvis Homestead is a year round destination. Whether it's is exploring Acadia in the summertime, experiencing the gorgeous Maine fall colors, or enjoying the relaxation/coziness and snow activities during the winter. Our home is an opportunity to experience Maine like a true Mainer. You’ll probably visit Acadia NP and Bar Harbor (we very much recommend you do, it’s only a 30min drive!), but we also hope you take the opportunity to experience other gorgeous Maine coastal towns. Our location is very centrally located and offers easy access to many beautiful attractions, plus an endless amount of hiking trails, lakes and ponds, rivers and ski hills.

→    Below are a few featured travel articles on Ellsworth and its surrounding area, including things to do and see in all seasons:

• 10 Best Small Towns in Maine, According to a Local ~ Travel and Leisure

• Top Reasons Why Staying in Ellsworth Maine is the Best

• Day Off Diaries: Where A Local Chef Goes for Lobster Rolls and Craft Brews Near Acadia National Park ~ Conde Nast Traveler

• The Perfect Winter Vacation in Maine's Acadia National Park — From Climbing Frozen Waterfalls to Cross-country Skiing ~ Travel and Leisure

• Col. Charles and Mary Ann Jarvis Homestead ~ Wikipedia

-
-
-

▪▪▪▪▪ OUR HOME LAYOUT ▪▪▪▪▪

→    Jarvis Homestead is a very special and historical place in the Downeast region of Maine. Over 200 years, the >7,500 sqft that makes up the home has been immaculately cared for. The design of the home is perfect for large groups - not only are there plenty of bedrooms but also several living rooms and common areas. We have layouts of the home in the listing photos.

→    The house is located right off Main St (which can sometimes get busy during peak hours) and provides guests with an easy walk to the beautiful Union River (2 min walk) and lovely downtown Ellsworth (4 min walk).

→    The house consists of two different sections:
1) The main house, built in 1828, oozes character and showcases the grand design and unique architecture
2) The “cottage” area, an addition of the house that is directly connected to the main house and gives more of a backwoods, cozy Maine cabin feel

▪FIRST FLOOR: Consists of the gorgeous double parlor living rooms (one with a 70” smart TV), the peaceful sun porch for morning coffee, the cozy library for reading and movies, the grand formal dining room for meals for the entire family, the original butlers pantry, and the fully functional/stocked main kitchen and laundry room

▪SECOND FLOOR: Made up of seven beautiful bedrooms and three full bathrooms. Five of the bedrooms have one queen bed (three of these bedrooms have desks for working), one bedroom has two queen beds and a working desk, and the last bedroom has one full bed with a working desk as well

▪THIRD FLOOR/LOFT: Dedicated to game and movie nights for the friends and families. It contains four twin beds (PLEASE NOTE: it gets quite hot up there but we have installed a portable AC for day time. It gets significantly cooler up there at night). There is a large smart TV, Mortal Kombat arcade game, a large game table to play the several different board games and puzzles provided, and an Xbox One with two controllers

▪COTTAGE: Connected to the main kitchen and laundry room. This adorable area provides another living space with a desk and TV, a bedroom with a queen bed, one room with a twin bed, and a small gym space with basic workout equipment (treadmill, bike, yoga mats, small weights). 

▪OUTDOOR AREA, POOL AND HOT TUB: Provides relaxation, fun for family and friends, and a breath of fresh Maine air. Enjoy the refreshing private pool surrounded by nature, relax in the outdoor hot tub, get competitive with one of the several lawn games, chat in the shade under the gazebo, and warm up next to the propane fire pit at night. [The space] Guests have the entire house to themselves. Although, the basement and carriage house (located on the property) will be locked at all times. [Guest access] -Only House Rule: No parties or loud noises outside after 9pm. You are more than welcome to continue the fun inside. Unfortunately, we will impose a $500 fine and ask guests to leave the property immediately if this rule is broken. Other than that, please have a fantastic time!

-Just like most houses in Maine, this is a very beautiful, but old house. It has been upgraded, maintained and cared for immaculately and we are so excited to share it with the world, but please read the house rules provided (even though there aren’t many) and the guides around the house to help you navigate through a few things that might be different to you. With that being said, all appliances are brand new and work wonderfully. The house is extremely comfortable and will be fully stocked throughout your stay! [Other things to note]

Cornerstone Cottage: historic oceanfront Maine retreat
*125 ft private oceanfront + direct shore access
*Oceanfront fire pit + cozy wood stove evenings
*Covered porch with sweeping water & Acadia views

Peaceful coastal setting outside Acadia National Park Cornerstone Cottage
Wake to the sound of the ocean just beyond your window and spend slow mornings watching the light shift across the water toward Acadia’s mountains.
Cornerstone Cottage is a historic oceanfront Maine retreat designed for gathering, exploring, and reconnecting — where days are shaped by salty air, coastal breezes, and evenings around the fire.
A peaceful oceanfront retreat outside the bustle of Bar Harbor—about 30 minutes from Acadia National Park and downtown Bar Harbor. The drive is part of the trade-off: you’ll return each day to private shorefront, mountain views, and the quiet pace of DownEast Maine.

Slow Mornings at the Cottage
*125 ft private oceanfront with seasonal shore access
*Covered porch overlooking the water & Acadia mountain views
*Thoughtfully stocked kitchen with spices and gathering essentials
*Locally roasted Maine coffee, tea, French press & pour-over
*Large lawn for slow afternoons, games, and outdoor activities 

Coastal Evenings & Gathering Spaces
*Oceanfront fire pit with firewood provided
*Indoor wood-burning stove for cooler coastal nights
*Outdoor grill and lobster pot for classic Maine dinners
*Bluetooth Bose speakers and cozy gathering spaces throughout

Exploring Acadia & the Coast
*Walking distance to Lamoine State Park and Lamoine Beach
*15 minutes to the Acadia Gateway Center
*Easy access to Acadia hiking, carriage roads, and scenic drives
*~30 minutes to Bar Harbor and the heart of Mount Desert Island
*50 min from the Schoodic section of Acadia
After a day exploring Acadia, return to the quieter side of the coast — away from the crowds and overlooking the ocean.

A Bit of the Story
Once part of a historic coastal hotel, Cornerstone Cottage has welcomed guests to Maine’s shoreline for more than 100 years.
Original wood floors, ocean breezes drifting through open windows, and thoughtful collected details reflect the slower rhythm of coastal Maine life.
While the cottage does not have air conditioning, its shaded setting, coastal breezes, and fans throughout the home help keep the space comfortable during warmer months — much like a traditional Maine summer cottage was meant to feel.
In cooler seasons, the wood stove becomes a natural gathering place after days spent exploring the coast.


Know Before You Book
A little farther from the crowds, a lot closer to the Maine experience.
Cornerstone Cottage is located in peaceful Lamoine, approximately 30 minutes from Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park. You'll want a car to explore the area, but you'll return to a quiet oceanfront retreat away from the crowds.

A Note About Nature
Cornerstone Cottage is surrounded by Maine’s coastal landscape, where wildlife sightings may include deer, seals, bald eagles, and other native wildlife.
As with any waterfront setting, occasional insects are part of the natural environment. The home is professionally treated and carefully maintained to ensure a comfortable stay.

Your private slice of paradise, close to Acadia, is waiting for you at Heron's Hideaway on Partridge Cove, part of the Mount Desert Narrows! Designed with mobility and comfort in mind, set on 5 acres, you're sure to love the expansive back yard, wildlife sightings, kayaks, game room and outdoor grilling, dining and marshmallow roasting! The house somehow feels both cozy and intimate, yet also provides enough space for your friends and family to sprawl out. This special place is yours to explore! Take in sunset views over the cove as you wander out through the tall ocean grass on a custom-built boardwalk leading to the fire pit – with seating for all. Make your way through our woodland path to the dock and hop in a kayak to explore the cove. Cozy up inside to the newly built propane fireplace with a plush blanket and a good book. Shoot hoops, test your video game skills or see if you have the right touch to score big points at ping pong or shuffle board in the game room. In the warmer months, you can take out a kayak and you may find a local harbor seal or grey seal swimming nearby. Play yard games on the gently rolling lawn that sprawls out between the patio and the ocean. The outdoor patio features a hot tub, propane grill, propane fire pit table and outdoor dining for 15.

If you appreciate special considerations for mobility, the property offers a sprawling first floor, with the primary kitchen, dining, living space, game room and bedrooms all on the first floor. There are several walk-in showers, including a step-in seated whirlpool spa tub for a private spa or bath experience without the need to climb into and out of a tub. The immediate surrounding property is flat, including the patio, which features our outdoor patio dining area for 15 and there is a section of the patio that is covered to shield you from the sun and rain.

Downstairs, take your pick between 3 king bedrooms and one bunk bed room with a full over a queen. Upstairs, you can enjoy the king suite with a twin bed tucked back in the corner and another bedroom with two twin beds attached. Enjoy the convenience of 3 full bathrooms downstairs and 1 full bathroom upstairs.

If you are hoping for a local wildlife sighting, this is the place. If you look carefully, you are sure to see some combination of deer, seals, eagles, falcons, herons, porcupines or possibly an elusive coyote, fox or moose.
