Private Boat Trip and Dinner on Cranberry Island: From June-August, you can request a private water taxi to pick you up at your dock and head out to Isleford Dock Restaurant on Little Cranberry Island for an incredible waterfront sunset and some of the most amazing off-the-boat seafood dining in the area, and see seals at Bunker Ledge and Baker Island Lighthouse along the way!

🦞 Watch the lobster boats and sailing yachts pass by and see the fog roll in and out with the weather while listening to the foghorns as you relax in an Adirondack chair high above the harbor. 

*******************************************
🏠 About our vintage coastal home:

At Harborside on Main, we have retained the original antique character of this amazing space—complete with hundred-year-old wide board pine floors, original wooden double-hung windows, and a massive deck with Adirondack chairs and picnic tables overlooking Southwest Harbor across Main Street. Our efforts to preserve the historic character of this part of Mount Desert Island means you are staying in a vintage structure that has been lived and loved by generations before you—and we have endeavored to retain all of the antique charm that comes with that history while making all possible upgrades for comfort and convenience. 

Our home is newly furnished as to all upholstery and bedding and decorated with original family heirlooms and antiques throughout. We have installed brand-new stainless and vintage-retro appliances throughout in keeping with the antique aesthetic. 

*********************************************

Your host Kristen has been hosting and guiding vacationers in unique Maine experiences since she began her professional life as a Registered Maine Guide leading overnight sea kayak trips to offshore islands. Before restoring houses, she restored antique wooden Maine Friendship sloops for charter tours on the island. We've shifted gears to restoring historic Mount Desert Island cottages (that would otherwise be torn down and/or gutted, stripping them of their historic charm). We have preserved this home’s original character so that we can be part of the preservation effort, but also because we truly enjoy offering our guests the unique experience of staying in an original, antique Maine island cottage.

Our restored cottages are the types of homes we seek out ourselves in our own travels around the world.  

*******************************************************
PLEASE READ ANTIQUE HOME DETAILS BEFORE BOOKING: 

This is an antique cottage on the coast of Maine. It is an antique on purpose, not by accident. So while we just put her through a four month restoration, this is a custom restoration effort—not a Home Depot special. We retained this vintage character because many people come to Maine seeking an experience that melds the beautiful coastal outdoors with our unique maritime history, New England architecture, and authentic vintage appeal. We restored this home with these guests in mind. 

Over a century ago, this house wasn’t built to look like any other house on the street, it was proudly custom-built by Maine craftsmen. Architecturally, the home is considered a classic New Englander construction—similar to the one next door, and others along the Maine coast. It was, however, built slightly differently than the one next door in the sense that it started its life as a sturdily-built sea-captain's house, built with a granite foundation and dressed up with decorative cornice brackets under the eves that resemble waves in color and shape. 

Once inside you’ll notice that the walls of this house are original restored plaster and lathe, so they are NOT perfectly square. They are not perfectly square, because they are not modern drywall. The walls were laid by hand over a hundred years ago. We restored the original plaster finish and gave everything 3-5 coats of fresh paint in neutral, historic, fresh Benjamin Moore color. To that end, we didn’t rip out the eight-inch baseboard with crown molding—we sanded and repainted it because it adds to the home’s unique character. Same with the decorative window trim that graces the beautiful original antique windows.

The windows are original leaded glass, five feet tall by three feet wide. They seem to stretch from the floor to the ceiling, and they let in incredible amounts of light. We had custom-built screens made for them so you can open them to let in the sea breeze. All of the windows work—but they are all original. They are original on purpose because they just don’t make them like this anymore. 

Harborside’s floors are original hand-milled pine, locally known as wide-board pine and sometimes King Pine, or Pumpkin Pine. These floors are a treasured characteristic of antique Maine homes. When restoring them, we stripped them down of several layers of vinyl and carpet and paint to bring them back to that original condition, and then, in keeping with Maine tradition, we refinished the floors in traditional Tung oil. These are not glossy pre-fab plastic or vinyl floors. They are 100% Maine pine and thus imperfect after being in use for over a century. The gaps that you may see between the boards are due to the fact that when these floors were built, they were meant to expand and contract with extremes of coastal Maine weather, and they still do—125 years later.

We hope you enjoy our home for the coastal Maine antique it is meant to be. If you are looking for a dog-friendly, traditionally restored, vintage coastal cottage on the coast of beautiful Acadia National Park, within walking distance to everything, please don’t hesitate to book! If you are looking for an off-the-shelf cookie-cutter style accommodation, our home may not be the right fit. If in doubt or you have questions, please ask before booking. Thoughtfully designed for comfort after a day exploring Acadia, this spacious, private 6-bedroom retreat sleeps up to 14, featuring 4 king beds,  a queen bed, and a bunk room ideal for families and groups. Enjoy easy access to scenic trails and shores, then unwind in the hot tub, game room, or wraparound deck for outdoor dining, grilling, fire-pit evenings, and stargazing. A fully stocked kitchen and inviting spaces make it easy for kids to play, adults to relax, and guests to gather or retreat. Gather around the table after a day in Acadia, soak in the hot tub beneath the stars, challenge each other in the game loft, and wake up ready for another day of adventure.

This isn't just a place to sleep while visiting Acadia—it's a place designed for families and friends to gather, reconnect, and make memories together.

WHAT MAKES THIS HOME SPECIAL

✔ Ideally located for exploring Acadia National Park and Mount Desert Island

✔ Sleeps up to 14 guests

✔ 6 bedrooms: 4 kings + 1 queen + a custom bunk room with 4 full beds

✔ 7-person hot tub beneath the stars

✔ Fire pit & outdoor gathering spaces

✔ Game loft with pool, air hockey, shuffleboard, & more

✔ Swivel hammock chairs & deck hammock for relaxing outdoors

✔ Open-concept living area with soaring cathedral ceiling

✔ Fully equipped kitchen and space for shared group meals inside and out

✔ Oversized outdoor dining table seating 12+ guests

✔ Air conditioning in living areas and every bedroom

✔ High-speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs throughout

✔ Quality linens, complimentary toiletries, coffee bar, and more

✔ Home office workstation

✔ Board games + lawn games

✔ Private 2.5 acre forested lot

✔ Up to 2 dogs are welcome. Add pets to the reservation when you book. Our pet fee is $150.

GATHER TOGETHER

At the heart of the home is a bright, open-concept living area where everyone naturally comes together. The cathedral ceiling, comfortable seating, and thoughtful design create a space that feels both spacious and welcoming.

The fully equipped kitchen features a large island, ample prep space, and everything needed for quick breakfasts before a hike and lobster dinners after a day in Acadia.

The dining and gathering spaces are designed for shared meals and conversation. Seating at the dining table and kitchen island makes it easy to gather indoors, while the oversized outdoor dining table accommodates 12+ guests. A high chair is available for our youngest travelers.

The home is equipped with a Keurig Duo coffee maker that brews both pods and carafes, as well as a propane grill for outdoor cooking.

Fast Wi-Fi keeps everyone connected, while two washers and two dryers make longer stays easy.

RELAX & PLAY

When you're not exploring Acadia, the game loft offers a second gathering space for friendly competition and rainy-day fun. Challenge each other to pool, air hockey, shuffleboard, wall basketball, and board games, or simply settle in and relax between adventures.

Outside, the pace slows down even more. Spend the evening soaking in the 7-person hot tub beneath the stars, gathering around the fire pit, sharing a meal, relaxing in the hammock chairs, or enjoying a quiet morning coffee surrounded by trees.

WHERE EVERYONE SLEEPS

First Floor:

Bedroom 1: King bed, 55" Smart TV, en suite bathroom, home office workstation
Bedroom 2: King bed, 55" Smart TV, peaceful forest view
Bedroom 3: King bed, 55" Smart TV, peaceful forest view

Second Floor:

Bedroom 4: King bed, 55" Smart TV, tranquil forest view through two large windows
Bedroom 5: Queen bed, 55" Smart TV, sunny and bright with forest view
Bedroom 6: Bunk room with 4 full beds tucked into custom nooks, 55" Smart TV, forest view

Bedrooms feature comfortable mattresses, hotel-style bedding, blackout curtains, Smart TVs, and thoughtful design details throughout. One of the home's most memorable spaces is the custom bunk room. Inspired by Acadia's forests, it combines four full-sized beds in built-in bunk nooks with warm lighting, rich textures, and woodland-inspired design elements to create a cozy retreat.

A Pack 'n Play is available for families traveling with infants and toddlers, and retractable gates are available to help keep little ones off the stairs.

BATHROOMS

There are three full bathrooms stocked with towels and essentials, including an en suite bathroom in the primary bedroom suite.

LOCATION

The home is ideally situated for exploring everything Mount Desert Island has to offer.

Many guest favorites—including Southwest Harbor's shops and restaurants, Bass Harbor Head Light, Seawall, Wonderland Trail, Ship Harbor Trail, Echo Lake Beach, and scenic Adadia hikes—are within 10 to 20 minutes of the house.

When you're ready to explore Cadillac Mountain, Jordan Pond, Sand Beach, Thunder Hole, Bar Harbor, and Acadia's other iconic east-side destinations, they're easily accessible by car, typically about 30–35 minutes away depending on traffic and where you're headed.

THE EXPERIENCE

Whether your perfect Acadia vacation includes sunrise hikes, days near the water, lobster dinners, family game nights, stargazing from the hot tub, or simply slowing down and spending time together, this home was designed to bring everyone together and serve as a comfortable base for making lasting memories. [The space] Guests have exclusive access to the entire home and surrounding property, including all indoor living spaces, bedrooms, outdoor areas, yard, fire pit, and hot tub. The only area not accessible to guests is the unfinished basement, which is locked and reserved for owner storage and maintenance. [Guest access] 🔧HOT TUB & OTHER AMENITIES: We take great care to maintain the home and its amenities, but availability may occasionally be interrupted by maintenance, equipment issues, weather, or safety concerns. As part of our hot tub maintenance routine, a member of our team may need to stop by during your stay to check the water chemistry; we’ll always ask you first.

🚗 ROAD ACCESS: The final half mile to the home and the driveway are gravel. Please drive at 10 mph or less on these neighborhood roads and watch for children playing or walking to school. Four wheel drive is advised in winter months.

📶 CELL SERVICE: Cell service can be spotty on some nearby roads, but free high-speed Wi-Fi keeps you connected at the house.

👣 STAIRS: Access to the home requires climbing a flight of 9 stairs from the driveway to the front porch. Once inside, the main living areas, three bedrooms, and two full bathrooms are located on the first floor. The game loft and an additional three bedrooms and full bath are on the second floor.

🦌 WILDLIFE: The house is surrounded by nature, and wildlife sightings are part of the experience! Deer and foxes have been spotted on the property, and we’d love to hear what other visitors you see during your stay. Mosquitoes may also be present during the warmer months, especially around dawn and dusk, and ticks are possible throughout the region. We treat the property to help reduce both.

🌱 LAWN: We're establishing new grass in the backyard. During this time, portions of the yard may appear thin or patchy, and a sprinkler system may be set to run on schedule to help the grass establish. 

🏡 A NOTE ABOUT OUR NEIGHBORHOOD & APPROPRIATE USE OF THE HOUSE: The house sits on a private 2.5-acre property in a peaceful residential area. Neighboring homes are located nearby, and sound carries easily in this quiet rural setting.

This is a wonderful home for families, friends, hiking groups, and loved ones gathering to enjoy Mount Desert Island and Acadia — but it is not a party house. 

Parties, events, disruptive noise, loud music, and nuisance behavior are never permitted. Consideration for our neighbors is needed at all hours. Quiet hours are 10pm–8am. After 10pm, enjoyment of outdoor areas must be limited to quiet conversation. 

The rule prohibiting parties extends to any party-focused gathering, such as a bachelor/bachelorette party, that could involve heavy drinking, loud music, loud outdoor socializing, or disruptive conduct. This kind of stay is not allowed.

Events also are not permitted. This property may not be used for organized retreats, workshops, classes, seminars, photo shoots, weddings, receptions, or similar activities, whether paid or unpaid. 

Prior approval is required before bringing any service provider onto the property, such as a private chef, photographer, or yoga instructor.

Please see our house rules for more details. [Other things to note]
